channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Judge says anti-weaponization case issues remain active despite DOJ push
item.description: Judge Brinkema questioned whether the Trump administration's Anti-Weaponization Fund was truly dissolved or if the DOJ Judgment Fund acts as its equivalent.

item.title: Foreign hackers breach two more US water utilities, threaten Colorado safety
item.description: Foreign hackers breached two Colorado water utilities, altering pumping cycles and disabling alarms before operators regained control of systems.

item.title: Socialist Claire Valdez faces calls for federal probe after Mexico pledge
item.description: New York City socialist Claire Valdez faces Logan Act scrutiny after meeting Mexico's Morena party and vowing to carry independence fight to Congress.
